categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of stainless steel wire rods, carbon steel wire rods, alloy steel wire rods, and free-cutting steel wire rods. It also engages in processing and wholesale/retail of steel pipes, mechanical parts, steel strips, and surface treatment of alloy and stainless steel. Additional business includes manufacturing parts for motorcycles and bicycles, construction and leasing of residential and commercial buildings, steel plate processing, mechanical design and manufacturing, galvanized and painted steel plate production, and agricultural and livestock farming.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced steel processing technologies including cold drawing, annealing, rolling, acid pickling, and solution treatment to produce various steel wire products. It emphasizes continuous process improvements, energy-saving measures, and development of new steel grades such as 409Cb, YCS550, 1215MS, and 10B21/10B33. The company also implements TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) and 5S management systems to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the screw, nut, spring, electronic products, aerospace, automotive, medical, and hardware industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with domestic sales accounting for approximately 84% and exports about 16%, primarily to the United States, Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, and Europe. The products are used as raw materials for various industrial components and construction materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with domestic sales distributed nationwide. Its export markets include the United States, Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, and Europe. It plans to expand further into European and Southeast Asian markets while maintaining existing markets in the US and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on processing steel billets into wire rods and related products. It sources raw materials such as steel billets from upstream suppliers, including affiliated companies, and supplies processed steel wire products downstream to manufacturers and industrial users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding stainless steel wire rod supply, strengthening carbon steel wire rod market share, and transitioning to high-value niche stainless steel products. The company invests in R&D to develop new steel grades and sizes, improve production processes for energy efficiency and carbon reduction, and enhance product quality. It also focuses on sustainability initiatives such as carbon footprint management and renewable energy adoption.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of stainless steel and carbon steel wire rods and related steel products. The company earns income from domestic and international product sales, including customized steel grades and sizes. It also derives revenue from contract manufacturing and processing services for carbon steel billets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from global and regional steel producers, including integrated stainless steel manufacturers and independent wire rod processors. It differentiates itself through product quality, diverse steel grades, flexible production, rapid delivery, and customer service. The company leverages group synergies and upstream steel billet sourcing to maintain competitive cost structures and market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported annual revenue of approximately NT$6.9 billion, a 37.58% increase from the previous year, but incurred a pre-tax loss of NT$1.08 billion. The company has a total asset base of about NT$12.67 billion and equity of NT$5.32 billion. Despite recent losses, it shows growth in sales volume and is investing in capacity expansion and sustainability projects, indicating a focus on medium to long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality stainless steel wire rods with a wide range of steel grades and sizes, rapid delivery, and customized solutions to meet diverse customer needs. It focuses on product innovation, energy-efficient and environmentally friendly production, and strong customer service. Its integration with upstream steel suppliers and commitment to sustainability provide competitive advantages in cost control and market responsiveness.
